standard.summary: 支持预热的调度器在训练开始时，用这些步数将学习率从较低值线性增长到目标值，降低初期更新过大的风险。
standard.effect: 正数优先于 warmup_ratio，实际预热步数不超过总步数减 1；设为 0 时回退到 warmup_ratio。预热后进入所选调度器的后续阶段，起始学习率由调度器决定。
standard.whenToUse: 推荐总步数的 5%~10% 作为预热。总步数 500 时，warmup=25~50。使用高学习率（>5e-4）时更需要预热。
standard.avoidWhen: 极短训练可缩短或关闭预热；关闭时需同时将 lr_warmup_steps 和 warmup_ratio 设为 0。不支持预热的调度器不会使用此参数。

standard_en.summary: For schedulers that support warmup, the number of initial steps used to raise the learning rate linearly from a lower value to the target, reducing the risk of overly large early updates.
standard_en.effect: A positive value takes precedence over warmup_ratio and is capped at total steps minus 1. A value of 0 falls back to warmup_ratio. After warmup, the selected schedule continues; the starting learning rate depends on the scheduler.
standard_en.whenToUse: 5%~10% of the total steps is the recommended warmup. With 500 total steps that is warmup=25~50. A high learning rate (>5e-4) needs warmup more.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Short runs may need less or no warmup. To disable it, set both lr_warmup_steps and warmup_ratio to 0. Schedulers without warmup support do not use this parameter.

advanced.principle: 线性预热期 lr_t = lr_start + (lr_target - lr_start) × t / warmup_steps。cosine 默认从目标学习率的 1% 开始，预热结束后衰减到最低学习率；续训沿用 checkpoint 保存的调度进度，不重新预热。
advanced.tradeoffs: 预热过短 → 初期大幅度更新可能影响基础能力；预热过长 → 占用太多有效训练步数。

advanced_en.principle: Linear warmup: lr_t = lr_start + (lr_target - lr_start) × t / warmup_steps. cosine starts at 1% of the target LR by default and decays to the minimum after warmup; resume follows the scheduler progress saved in the checkpoint without re-warming.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Too short a warmup → large early updates may hurt base capability; too long → wastes effective training steps.
